tokensNote: tokens.txt is GENERATED and is a pure function of tokensSource. Never hand-edit it; regenerate instead. tokensSource is duplicated inside gen-tokens.sh — keep both in sync.

tokenRule.summary: Figma MCP emits slash- and dot-separated names. Normalise both.
tokenRule.note: Never invent a token name. Every name written into CSS must exist verbatim in tokensManifest.

iconSpec.note: The kit ships no icons. Author them locally; never import an icon library.

invariants.note: True for every component in this kit — do not read ui-kit source to re-verify.

instanceRule.summary: A Figma layer is a component instance if its subtree carries instance-prefixed ids; resolve every instance through figmaComponents below.
instanceRule.isComponent: the layer's own id starts with 'I', OR any descendant id starts with 'I<layerId>;' — e.g. layer 2159:2941 with child I2159:2941;1:12476 is a Badge instance
instanceRule.isPlainFrame: no 'I'-prefixed ids anywhere in the subtree — e.g. 2159:2935 → hand-roll, even if the layer is named like a component
instanceRule.note: The layer's own id alone is NOT the signal — instances usually expose the prefix on their children. Guard against lookalikes: a frame named 'CountBadge' with no I-ids is not a <Badge>.

statusMeaning.implemented: use the kit component; detect the variant from token names in the MCP output (--button-ghost-* → ghost), never from the layer name
statusMeaning.shim: kit component with the base variant + shim class from src/shims/button-variants.module.css — see Button.kit.md → 'Unimplemented variants'
statusMeaning.tokens-only: no kit component, but its token family exists — use/create the stub in src/shims/<Component>/ built strictly on that family
statusMeaning.missing: no component, no tokens — hand-roll + mandatory drift-report entry

figmaComponents.syncNote: Statuses are maintained by /sync-ai-map against the ui-kit TS types. tokens.txt CANNOT detect an implemented variant/component — the tokens usually pre-exist the implementation.
